Sophie — attaching the MAP (v3) and the proposed evaluation plan for Clearline. High level ask: if the scope below looks correct, can we lock a signature window (DocuSign) for the last week of June and target a Day 1 of July 7?

Quick summary:
- MAP milestones: POC evaluation (2 weeks), security review (3 business days), procurement signature
- Acceptance criteria: latency under 120ms p95 on sample workload; embedding accuracy threshold (eval set attached)
- Signatures needed: Legal + Procurement + Exec sponsor

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf, SOW_Clearline_Redwood_v1.docx, pricing_summary.csv

Can you confirm availability for a staggered signature cadence (legal first, procurement last) and whether July 7 Day 1 works? If you prefer a single-day signing we can compress but would need legal sign-off by June 24.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates so we can reserve capacity.

— Priyom

Aditya: please tentatively reserve 2x gpus of Dedicated pool for the POC window (Jul 7 to Jul 21). If capacity conflicts appear, escalate to infra team lead by June 24.

Camila: legal notes —
- Log retention: default 90 days is fine. Add a short clause in SOW that logging for production evaluation will be limited to telemetry/operational logs; PHI must not be stored in logs per Clearline request.
- I’ll sign off on the SOW language in the version Priyom will send to me by EOD.

- June 24: Legal (Clearline) completes review and countersign (DocuSign envelope routed)
- June 26: Procurement executes the SOW in DocuSign

- July 7: Day 1 (onboarding + capacity handoff)

Priyom — go ahead and send the updated SOW & DocuSign link; I’ll review language and countersign once legal confirms.

— Marissa
